title: Cosmic Wolf Sorceress
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a robed sorceress with a crown of colorful glowing orbs standing on a swirling green landscape. To her right, a large black wolf howls at a glowing moon while a crescent moon with intricate patterns drips beside it; floating bubbles containing faces and cosmic scenes fill the starry purple sky.
